dataset: Han et al. (2022), GJI, DOI 10.1093/gji/ggab386, Table 1
status: retrospective external test; observations were already publicly visible; no fractured electrical target used in calibration
calibration: m_j = log(sigma_Ij / sigma_w) / log(phi_Ij); sigma_bj = sigma_w * phi_b^m_j
nominal_phi_b: phi_total - phi_crack; matches companion Part II bulk-normalized convention
brine_source: Han2018 same nominal salinity; transferred, not measured for Han2022 batch
aperture_source: 1.0 is manufacturing geometry, not measured 5 MPa aperture; 0 and 0.5 are prescribed closure scenarios, not probability bounds
geometry: one centered finite oblate spheroid in a mirror-symmetric periodic orthogonal cell; V=a^3/epsilon; xy width=sqrt(V/spacing)
geometry_status: regular-array surrogate; not reconstruction of actual random crack coordinates
specimen_boundary_conditions: full end faces at 0 and 1 V; curved side insulated; rotate homogenized tensor relative to specimen axis
cell_boundary_conditions: principal-axis end faces at 0 and 1 V; transverse faces insulated, corresponding to the mirror-symmetric array
solver: body-fitted linear tetrahedral finite elements, scipy CG/AMG or sparse direct solve
sensitivity_interpretation: deterministic model scenarios, not an experimental confidence interval; no realization is selected by observed error
